STATUS_GRAMMAR_AS_LANDED.rule: a window is label-admissible ONLY when an OFFICIAL resolution exists AND the checker reads VERIFIED_AGREE. Every other outcome is a COUNTED STATUS and carries NO label.

FALSIFIERS_18_ALL_PASS.positive_exact_endpoint: VERIFIED_AGREE both directions, and a TIE reads UP as the convention pins it
FALSIFIERS_18_ALL_PASS.known_bad_rolling_as_raw: REFUSED ROLLING_TWAP_PASSED_WHERE_A_RAW_AGGREGATE_PATH_IS_REQUIRED -- crypto_prices_twap_sixty is the ROLLING statistic; each sample already contains the preceding 60s, so integrating it double-counts. The same topic in its OWN endpoint role is admitted, so the control can fail.
FALSIFIERS_18_ALL_PASS.statuses_never_labels: NO_OFFICIAL / NOT_IN_CAPTURE / MARGIN_BELOW_RESOLUTION / STALE_BOUNDARY each carry label=None
FALSIFIERS_18_ALL_PASS.hold: driven on 4 REAL disagreements -> ON_HOLD True; the honest rows do NOT hold the lane
FALSIFIERS_18_ALL_PASS.TWO_CELLS_I_HAD_TO_FIX_AND_WHY_IT_MATTER: the first inverted-mapping cell used ONE symbol, so the swap pointed at a series that did not exist and every row returned NOT_IN_CAPTURE -- DETECTION BY ABSENCE, which passes while proving nothing about the mapping. The second wrote every window under the SAME (symbol,60) key so later windows clobbered earlier ones. And the first HOLD cell carried an `or not any(...)` escape that made it pass at n_disagree=0 -- a control that cannot fail. All three are fixed and the comment recording them is in the module. R-229's class, caught in my own first pass.
